acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
LC-MS/MS data-dependent analysis was performed using an Exploris480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a Dionex Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were reduced with 5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine and alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were reduced with 5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine and alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Next, 0.5 μg of trypsin was added and incubated for 16–18 hours at 37 °C with shaking at 700 rpm.

collision_energy.evidence: MS/MS spectra were collected with a normalized HCD collision energy of 36, 0.7 m/z isolation window, 150 millisecond maximum injection time, a normalized AGC target of 200%, at a MS2 orbitrap resolution of 45,000 with a defined first mass of 110 m/z to ensure measurement of TMTPro reporter

enrichment_method.evidence: 10 mg of lysate representing one biological replicate was incubated for 2 hours at 4 °C with anti-Kv11.1 antibody (Cell Signaling #12889) covalently coupled to protein A/G magnetic beads.

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptides were eluted from the first C18 phase onto the SCX resin using a 10 µL injection of buffer A with the following 90-minute gradient: 2% B (5-minute hold) ramped to 40% B over 35 minutes, ramped to 80% B over 15 minutes, held at 80% B for 5 minutes, then returned to 2% B in 5 minutes and then held at 2% B for the remainder of the analysis at a constant flow rate 500 nL/min.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS/MS spectra were collected with a normalized HCD collision energy of 36, 0.7 m/z isolation window, 150 millisecond maximum injection time, a normalized AGC target of 200%, at a MS2 orbitrap resolution of 45,000 with a defined first mass of 110 m/z to ensure measurement of TMTPro reporter

ionization_type.evidence: Electrospray ionization was performed directly from the analytical column by applying a voltage of 2.2 kV with an MS inlet capillary temperature of 275 °C and a RF lens of 40%.

mass_analyzer.evidence: at a MS2 orbitrap resolution of 45,000 with a defined first mass of 110 m/z to ensure measurement of TMTPro reporter
